summary: Alight, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 18, 2026, announcing a 1-for-20 reverse stock split effective June 30, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET. The reverse split applies to all classes of common stock, with a corresponding decrease in authorized shares. Stockholder approval was obtained at the June 10, 2026 annual meeting. Post-split, Class A common stock will trade on the NYSE under the symbol ALIT starting July 1, 2026, with a new CUSIP number 01626W 200. The board recommends the action to maintain NYSE listing compliance and pursue index inclusion. No premium, price per share, or deal terms apply; this is a routine capital adjustment, not an acquisition, tender, spin-off, or restructuring. There is no deal to arbitrage; the filing is purely administrative.
